Roster locations (PDF pages): Conference Committees p.170; 2026 Conference Chairpersons and Alternate Chairpersons, 2025 Trustees' Committees and Officers of the GSB p.171; Conference Members/Trustees pp.172-175; Nontrustee Directors pp.175-176; trustees/directors elected after the Conference pp.176-177; p.178 is a photo of a handwritten inscription (no roster); Area Delegates pp.179-180; nonvoting attendees, AAWS directors, AA Grapevine directors, GSO staff and Grapevine staff p.181; Trustee Farewells p.182. Theme, dates and location come from the title page (p.2) and opening narrative (p.4).

AUDIT (2025): an independent audit checked the source against the PDF page images rendered with PyMuPDF: p.170 (all 13 Conference committees, every member's mark, area, panel and secretary), p.171 (the 2026 chairs table, Trustees' Committees and GSB officers), pp.172-176 (every * rotating mark) and pp.179-180 (all 93 Area Delegates entries: area, name, panel and city). These all match. Every delegate is on exactly one primary committee. Every primary committee has 1 chair and 1 alternate chair, both from Panel 74, and every 2026 chair and alternate is a Panel 75 member of that committee. Changes made by the audit: the hyphenated-name format, Judith K. without the title, Jennifer B. Area 6, and the GM as Bob W. in aaws_directors (see above). Conference-member count cross-check: the narrative says "137 Conference members". Delegates 93, trustees other than Terry B. 22, nontrustee directors 6, GSO staff 13, Grapevine staff 2, GM 1 and Grapevine publisher 1 add up to 138, or 139 with Terry B. This supports the view that Terry B.'s Class A entry is stale. David S.: the 2023 file lists him among the general service trustees elected after the 2023 Conference. The 2025 report does not say this, so elected_year stays null.
